about: Apple search API responses (POST https://jobs.apple.com/api/v1/search, sort newest) recorded on 2026-11-14 with a plain request and no Origin or Referer header, trimmed to the fields the reader reads and summaries cut to 200 characters. retail_page is page 1 (20 managed pipeline retail roles, each dated the day of the request); corporate_page is page 6; mixed_page is page 20 (corporate roles and one retail role). Rows are in posted-date order apart from the pipeline roles.
